new_failures.failed_witness: Attempted the unavailable update-plan tool; the tool was absent and no state changed.
new_failures.recovery: Continued with the committed workflow and visible commentary without simulating a plan update.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect the actual active tool inventory before naming an orchestration helper.

new_failures.failed_witness: An inline PowerShell exit-code subexpression produced a parser fault before command execution.
new_failures.recovery: Split the probe into literal scalar commands and captured each exit code separately.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Avoid compound interpolated subexpressions in Windows lineage probes.

new_failures.failed_witness: A guessed central-repository path did not exist.
new_failures.recovery: Used the exact verified Liora worktree as the immutable Git-object source.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve the authoritative worktree before assuming a central checkout path.

new_failures.failed_witness: The roster parser guessed a root assignments key while the current v2 envelope uses projection.assignments.
new_failures.recovery: Inspected exact keys and parsed projection.assignments.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect the current JSON envelope before projecting route fields.

new_failures.failed_witness: A first exact-head file probe guessed older v682-style final paths.
new_failures.recovery: Listed the v684-v8 exact owner paths and used the actual final layout.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Discover current filenames before carrying a prior phase layout forward.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined display of large final documents exceeded the context window.
new_failures.recovery: Read required documents through bounded complete-file and exact-field projections.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use per-file bounds and scalar projections for large committed packets.

new_failures.failed_witness: A source summary emitted an invalid status_count value of negative one.
new_failures.recovery: Ran a separate porcelain-status scalar and proved a clean source.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not infer cleanliness from a faulty aggregate counter.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined x1 source-file display exceeded the output window.
new_failures.recovery: Used schema-aware function and exact-record projections.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Project only the functions and records required for the current builder.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined worktree and sparse probe returned no attributable output.
new_failures.recovery: Queried branch, head, clean state, and sparse configuration separately.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep lifecycle probes scalar and attributable.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first worktree-creation wrapper returned preparation text while checkout continued.
new_failures.recovery: Audited the live process, waited for the same operation, and verified the intended clean lane without replay.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Audit persisted process and worktree state before retrying a long checkout.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first bookbinding practice lens collided with a prior executed family phase.
new_failures.recovery: Rejected the lens at zero credit and continued the source-bounded novelty search.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Run exact and semantic practice checks before freezing a human-practice lens.

new_failures.failed_witness: The letterpress lens collided with prior Caelen Morrow and Caelen Ash evidence.
new_failures.recovery: Rejected the lens at zero credit and preserved the collision record.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Treat prior sibling practice evidence as a collision even when the proposed title differs.

new_failures.failed_witness: The footwear and cobbling lens collided with a prior Elowen full phase.
new_failures.recovery: Rejected the lens at zero credit and resumed bounded candidate screening.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Search morphology and related trade names before accepting a practice.

new_failures.failed_witness: A per-candidate full-tree grep continued beyond the output window.
new_failures.recovery: Stopped only the attributable diagnostic processes and replaced them with one bounded Git-object batch.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Batch Git-object novelty extraction once rather than recursively grepping for every candidate.

new_failures.failed_witness: A malformed JavaScript orchestration cell raised SyntaxError before any command or state change.
new_failures.recovery: Corrected the wrapper and kept repository state unchanged.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep orchestration cells minimal and syntax-check complex literals before execution.

new_failures.failed_witness: The stained-glass candidate collided with multiple prior owner phases.
new_failures.recovery: Rejected the lens at zero credit and preserved the collision.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Require a zero exact-practice-hit screen before drafting proposal titles.

new_failures.failed_witness: A broad footwear grep used the substring resol and overmatched generic resolution text.
new_failures.recovery: Used exact morphology-aware terms and bounded record extraction.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Avoid short ambiguous substrings in novelty searches.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined recursive bytecode-cache cleanup and diff probe was rejected by host safety policy before execution.
new_failures.recovery: Separated the read-only inventory from cleanup and proved that the staged repository state had not changed.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Never combine recursive cleanup with lifecycle diagnostics; inventory first and use only permitted literal operations.

new_failures.failed_witness: A literal-list PowerShell cache-cleanup wrapper was also rejected before execution.
new_failures.recovery: Kept the ignored bytecode artifacts outside repository credit and narrowed the attempted operation again.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Treat ignored interpreter caches as ambient artifacts when deletion authority is unavailable.

new_failures.failed_witness: A single exact-literal PowerShell bytecode deletion was rejected by host policy.
new_failures.recovery: Left the ignored cache outside tracked and untracked repository state and selected no-bytecode Python invocation for later validation.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use no-bytecode interpreter mode from the start and do not retry a policy-rejected deletion.

new_failures.failed_witness: A staged-state summary used a PowerShell wildcard for the literal question-mark status prefix and falsely counted all staged additions as untracked.
new_failures.recovery: Recomputed the untracked count with an exact StartsWith comparison while preserving the otherwise valid staged evidence.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use literal prefix comparisons for Git porcelain status codes rather than wildcard operators.
